candidates.primary_query: 베트남 여행 전 클러치 오토바이 타는 법
candidates.intent_rationale: Korean travellers who only ride automatic scooters or hold a car licence plan a northern Vietnam loop on a rented manual bike and look for a step-by-step way to learn clutch control before leaving.
candidates.content_angle: A Korean practice plan for the clutch lever: friction point, first-gear starts, up- and downshifts, hill starts and avoiding stalls, each tied to Hanoi stop-and-go traffic and the steep passes of the north.
candidates.working_title: 클러치 오토바이 타는 법: 베트남 여행 전에 연습해 둘 것

references.title: Oregon DMV Motorcycle and Moped Manual, Section 4: friction zone, starting and shifting
Kansas Motorcycle Handbook (based on the Motorcycle Safety Foundation operator manual)

candidates.intent_rationale: Korean riders used to their own country's blood-alcohol limit want to know whether a single beer with dinner already makes riding a rented scooter in Vietnam illegal, and what a roadside breath test means for a tourist.
candidates.content_angle: Explains Vietnam's zero-alcohol rule for every motor vehicle against Korean expectations, how breath checks and penalty tiers work under Decree 168/2024, why insurance cover is at stake and how to plan evenings without riding.
candidates.working_title: 베트남 음주운전 기준: 오토바이는 왜 맥주 한 잔도 안 될까

references.title: LuatVietnam: How are foreigners sanctioned for traffic violations in Vietnam?
Cần Thơ Department of Justice: alcohol-concentration penalties from 1 January 2025 (Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP)
THƯ VIỆN PHÁP LUẬT: criminal liability for riding a motorbike after drinking and causing an accident

candidates.intent_rationale: Riders planning longer rides outside Hanoi want the actual limits for motorbikes inside and outside residential areas, because Vietnamese limits depend on road layout and vehicle class rather than on posted signs alone.
candidates.content_angle: Tabulates motorbike and 50cc moped limits under Circular 38/2024 by road type, explains why motorbikes stay off expressways, how cameras and penalties work and how to read the local limit signs.
candidates.working_title: 베트남 오토바이 제한속도: 시내, 교외, 간선도로 기준 정리

references.title: LuatVietnam: Circular 38/2024/TT-BGTVT on speeds and safe distances of motor vehicles
THƯ VIỆN PHÁP LUẬT: motorbike speed limits under Circular 38/2024/TT-BGTVT and speeding penalties

candidates.intent_rationale: Koreans moving to Hanoi for work who hold no motorcycle class at home want to know whether they can sit the Vietnamese A1 test, separate from exchanging a Korean licence or using an international permit.
candidates.content_angle: Walks through the Vietnamese A1 route for foreign residents: eligibility, documents, theory and riding tests, where to register and licence validity, clearly separated from licence exchange and IDP use covered elsewhere.
candidates.working_title: 외국인이 베트남 오토바이 면허(A1)를 따는 방법: 시험과 서류

references.title: Viet Nam News: Using the roads in Việt Nam as a foreigner
LawNet: instructions for taking the tests for a class A1 motorcycle licence
THƯ VIỆN PHÁP LUẬT: Vietnamese driving licences held by foreigners and their renewal

candidates.intent_rationale: Renters who assume a Vietnamese rental bike is insured like a car at home want to know which compulsory cover exists, what it pays after an accident and which certificate they must carry at a police check.
candidates.content_angle: Explains Vietnam's compulsory third-party motorbike insurance under Decree 67/2023, what it leaves out (the rider's own injuries, the bike, unlicensed riding), how to check the certificate at pick-up and how it differs from travel insurance.
candidates.working_title: 베트남 오토바이 의무보험: 보상 범위와 렌트할 때 확인할 점

references.title: THƯ VIỆN PHÁP LUẬT: Decree 67/2023/ND-CP on compulsory civil liability insurance of motor vehicle owners (English translation)
Cần Thơ Department of Justice: what changed in compulsory motorbike and car insurance
Government document portal: Decree 67/2023/NĐ-CP on compulsory insurance

candidates.intent_rationale: Riders who cannot read Vietnamese want to recognise the signs that change what a scooter may do, such as motorbike bans, lane assignments and turning rules, because several look different from Korean signs.
candidates.content_angle: A sign-by-sign guide to the Vietnamese road signs that matter most on a scooter under QCVN 41:2024, grouped by the decision a rider must make, with notes on supplementary plates.
candidates.working_title: 베트남 도로 표지판: 오토바이 운전자가 꼭 알아야 할 표지

references.title: LawNet: Update of QCVN 41:2024/BGTVT on road signalling in Vietnam
Cần Thơ Department of Justice: national technical regulation on road signalling issued

candidates.intent_rationale: Koreans visiting between December and February expect tropical heat and meet damp cold and drizzle in the north; they want to know how riding conditions change and what to pack for a scooter trip.
candidates.content_angle: Covers the cool season in Hanoi and the northern mountains from a rider's view: humid cold, drizzle and slick roads, visibility, layering and gloves, and how cold spells affect day trips, distinct from the summer rains.
candidates.working_title: 하노이 겨울 오토바이 주행: 습한 추위와 이슬비 대비법

references.title: Travelfish: How cold does it really get in Hanoi?
Local Vietnam: Vietnam in winter, weather by region

candidates.intent_rationale: Travellers packing for a scooter trip want concrete clothing advice that balances protection against heat, sun and sudden downpours, beyond the helmet rules covered by another guide.
candidates.content_angle: A packing and wearing guide for Vietnam's climate: abrasion-resistant layers, gloves and closed shoes, rain gear that is safe on a scooter and sun protection, with what to buy locally and what to bring from Korea.
candidates.working_title: 베트남 오토바이 여행 복장: 더위, 비, 햇볕에 맞춘 옷차림

references.title: Local Vietnam: What to bring to Vietnam, packing list
Tigit Motorbikes: What to bring and wear in Vietnam

candidates.intent_rationale: Renters who remain responsible for the scooter during the rental want practical habits that keep the bike and their belongings safe in Hanoi before anything goes wrong.
candidates.content_angle: Prevention only: where and how to park, locks, keys and papers, snatch thefts of phones and bags from passing bikes and night-time habits, kept separate from the question of who pays after a theft.
candidates.working_title: 하노이 오토바이 도난 예방: 주차, 잠금장치, 날치기 대비

references.title: Government of Canada: Vietnam travel advice, safety and security (petty crime and bag snatching)
North Vietnam: Parking a motorbike in Vietnam, tips and rules
Local Vietnam: Driving and renting a motorbike in Hanoi

candidates.intent_rationale: Visitors riding into the Old Quarter or to sights want to know where a scooter may be left, how attended parking with paper tickets works and what happens if a bike is left on a pavement where it is not allowed.
candidates.content_angle: Explains how scooter parking works in Hanoi: attended lots and tickets, the city's official parking-fee rules, pavement restrictions and impounding, with practical tips for sights, cafés and night markets.
